title: 第一百零九章 古印传至尊残墟遇古凶第一百零八章 古印泄天机万古第一层局
content_zh:
：天机落尽，心海微凉。
整片太古残墟彻底陷入死寂，连虚空流动的微响都彻底消弭。
我伫立古印之前，指尖悬在斑驳古朴的印纹上方，迟迟未落。
脑海里还回荡着刚刚解锁的万古秘辛，一层层冰冷的棋局框架，死死钉在道心深处。
所谓诸天轮回，所谓天骄沉浮，所谓万古更迭。
说到底，不过是域外大能随手布设的一场养棋收割大戏。
我们是棋，是养料，是世代轮回里任人拿捏的蝼蚁。
良久，我轻轻吐了一口胸中郁气，肩背紧绷的血战线条缓缓松弛几分。
身后，宋思雨静静而立，白衣垂落，身姿温婉却挺拔。她没有出声打扰我的心境沉淀，只是眸光柔和地落在我背影，替我警戒四方潜藏的虚空暗机。
我微微垂眸，重新看向掌心悬浮的灰白古印。
天机只是真相，而非馈赠。
能在这片万古残墟镇守棋局第一层、留存至今不灭，这枚太古印绝不止记录秘辛这么简单。
我心神微动，神魂缓缓舒展，不再带着试探的锐利，取而代之的是一片纯粹、坦诚的道心共鸣。
“若你承载上古至尊道脉残存意志。”
“若你也不甘被人摆布、沦为棋子。”
“便予我机缘。”
“今日我破第一层棋局，来日，我替这残碎道脉，逆尽万古不公。”
话音轻落，字字落于虚空。
嗡——！
一声远比刚才更加深沉、更加古老的道音，从古印内核轰然炸开。

这一次不再是冰冷的信息流冲刷神魂，而是一缕温暖、霸道、苍茫到极致的至尊金光，从古印中央喷涌而出！
金辉不刺眼，却极其厚重。
像是沉寂亿万载的上古残魂，终于等到唯一契合的传承人。
漫天金色道纹化作流水长河，瞬间包裹我的全身！
我浑身一震，发丝无风自动，黑白主宰道果在道台之巅疯狂震颤、旋转、升华。
上古至尊·破局道韵！
无数残缺的至尊功法、上古杀式、域外大道本源理解，疯狂涌入我的脑海。
不是灌输神通，是补全我的道根短板。
我此前的逆道，是绝境杀出的逆、是挣脱禁锢的逆、是反抗强权的逆。
而此刻，古印传承让我彻底通透——
真正的逆道，是逆棋、逆命、逆诸天定数！
是从棋局根源，打破别人给你定下的所有格局！
体内原本已经圆满稳固的**宰初阶底蕴，在飞速膨胀、加厚、凝练。
被域外天地压制的最后一丝微弱桎梏，彻底烟消云散！
我周身黑白道韵隐隐镀上一层淡淡金边，道果纹路变得更加繁复、古老、圆满。
**宰初阶，彻底圆满无瑕！
甚至距离**宰中阶，只差一步薄薄的道境门槛。
content_en:
: The secret of heaven is gone, and my heart is slightly cold.
The entire ancient ruins fell completely into dead silence, and even the slight sound of flowing void was completely eliminated.
I stood in front of the ancient seal, my fingertips hovering above the mottled and simple prints, but they still lingered.
The eternal secrets that had just been unlocked were still echoing in his mind, and the layers of cold chess game framework were firmly nailed deep in the heart of the Tao.
The so-called reincarnation of heavens, the so-called ups and downs of geniuses, and the so-called changes of the ages.
In the final analysis, it is just a chess-raising and harvesting drama casually arranged by the powerful outsiders.
We are chess pieces, nourishment, and ants at the mercy of others in the reincarnation of generations.
After a long while, I let out a sigh of relief, and the tight blood lines on my shoulders and back slowly relaxed a bit.
Behind him, Song Siyu stood quietly, her white clothes hanging down, her posture gentle but upright. She didn't say anything to disturb my calm state of mind, but her eyes fell softly on my back, alerting me to the hidden secrets in the void.
I lowered my eyes slightly and looked again at the gray-white ancient seal suspended in my palm.
The secret is just the truth, not a gift.
Being able to guard the first level of the chess game in this ancient ruins and remain immortal to this day, this ancient seal is more than just a record of secrets.
My mind moved slightly, and my soul slowly relaxed. It no longer had the sharpness of temptation, but was replaced by a pure and frank Taoist heart resonance.
"If you carry the remaining will of the ancient supreme lineage."
"If you are not willing to be manipulated and reduced to a pawn."
"Give me a chance."
"Today I break the first level of the chess game. Tomorrow, I will fight against the injustice of the ages for this broken Dao."
The words fell softly, and the words fell into the void.
Buzz—!
A far deeper and more ancient sound than before exploded from the core of the ancient seal.
This time, it is no longer the cold flow of information washing over the soul, but a ray of warm, domineering, and extremely boundless supreme golden light, spurting out from the center of the ancient seal!
The golden glow is not dazzling, but extremely thick.
It was like the remnant soul of the ancient world, which had been dormant for hundreds of millions of years, finally found its only suitable successor.
The golden Dao pattern all over the sky turned into a long river of water, instantly covering my whole body!
My whole body was shaken, and my hair moved without any wind. The black and white dominator Dao Fruit trembled, rotated, and sublimated crazily on the top of the Taoist stage.
The Ancient Supreme·Breaking the Dao Yun!
Countless incomplete supreme skills, ancient killing styles, and understanding of the origin of extraterrestrial avenues crazily poured into my mind.
It's not about instilling magical powers, it's about making up for my shortcomings in the Tao.
My previous rebellion was the rebellion of fighting out of desperation, the rebellion of breaking free from imprisonment, and the rebellion of resisting power.
But at this moment, the ancient seal inheritance has made me completely transparent——
The real rebellion is to rebel against chess, destiny, and destiny!
It is to break all the patterns set by others from the root of the chess game!
The initial foundation of the Prime Minister, which was already complete and stable in the body, is rapidly expanding, thickening, and condensing.
The last weak shackles suppressed by the outside world completely disappeared!
The black and white Dao charm all over my body is faintly plated with a layer of gold, and the Dao fruit lines become more complex, ancient, and perfect.
**The first level of Zai, completely perfect and flawless!
There is only one thin step away from the intermediate level of Dao Realm.
